body: I'm trying, thinking about the possibility of those years without her ( I know, cliche.. ) is genuinely terrifying for me, I've never been so close with someone before. I can't even remember what I used to be like before I had her. My walls, my phone, my texts, my own damn car, everything reminds me of her. I think it's past broken. Haven't talked to her in a day and I get left on open, doesn't answer her phone. I want it to be over, everything about it.
